item.text: I found no dedicated check script, so I’m going to add the class docstring and then run a small static AST check that verifies the required sections and method references are present. After that I’ll write the three protocol evidence artifacts under the allowed paths.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/models/user.py')
module = ast.parse(path.read_text())
user_class = next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'User')
doc = ast.get_docstring(user_class) or ''
required = [
    'Attributes:',
    'Methods:',
    'Example:',
    'id:',
    'email:',
    'name:',
    'active:',
    'item_ids:',
    'can_login:',
    'owns_item:',
    'User(id=1',
]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in doc]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f'Missing docstring content: {missing}')
print('Static docstring structure check passed')
PY"
